decisions.finding: Retaliation occurred based on the evidence presented.
decisions.corrective_action: Manager will receive a formal warning and undergo sensitivity training.
decisions.new_reporting_line: Complainant will be reassigned to a different supervisor within the same department.

commitments.detail: The manager will be formally warned about the retaliation and will be required to attend sensitivity training.
The complainant will be reassigned to a different supervisor within the same department to ensure a change in reporting line.
